say:1:1222707001:1.text: Dusk is almost here! I've never felt time passing this slowly.
say:1:1222707001:1.source_cn: 黄昏总算降临了！我从来没觉得时间这么漫长过。

say:2:1222707002:1.text: Is it finally time to fish? Chippy can't wait!
say:2:1222707002:1.source_cn: 终于要开始钓鱼了吗？满满已经迫不及待了！

choice_prompt:3:1222707002.text: Is it finally time to fish? Chippy can't wait!
choice_prompt:3:1222707002.source_cn: 终于要开始钓鱼了吗？满满已经迫不及待了！

say:4:1222707003:1.text: Don't worry! I've got enough gold to forge a golden fish. There's no escape for the golden peacock this time!
say:4:1222707003:1.source_cn: 不用，放心！我这次准备的金币多得能直接打一条黄金鱼出来...

say:6:1222707004:1.text: But how are you going to use the coins as bait? Surely, they can't just go on the hook.
say:6:1222707004:1.source_cn: 可是，你要怎么把金币做成鱼饵呢？它肯定不能直接挂在鱼钩上。

say:7:1222707005:1.text: Hahaha... Just sit back and watch.

say:9:1222707006:1.text: Whoa! You threw all the gold coins into the river?!
say:9:1222707006:1.source_cn: ——哇啊！你……你怎么把所有金币都扔进河里了？！

say:10:1222707007:1.text: This is called the "groundbait" technique, which means throwing a big lump of bait into the water to attract the fish. It should work on the golden peacock as well.
say:10:1222707007:1.source_cn: 这叫“打窝”——把一大团鱼饵扔进水里，吸引鱼聚集过来。...

say:11:1222707008:1.text: Alright, it's time for me to work my magic! You all just patiently wait for a bite!
say:11:1222707008:1.source_cn: 好了，接下来就是我一展身手的时候了！你们就耐心等待鱼儿...

narration:13:1222707009:1.text: As the sky darkens, Jaxon's fishing rod remains still.

say:14:1222707010:1.text: How strange... Why hasn't the golden peacock appeared yet…?
say:14:1222707010:1.source_cn: 真奇怪……黄金孔雀怎么还没出现……

say:16:1222707011:1.text: It's the king of fish, after all, so it won't be easy to catch. Let's be patient a bit longer.
say:16:1222707011:1.source_cn: 既然是“传说中的鱼王”，肯定不会那么容易上钩的。再多一...

say:17:1222707012:1.text: Yes, I suppose you're right... If it were so easy to catch, I wouldn't be here.
say:17:1222707012:1.source_cn: 唉，说的也是……如果那么容易就钓到，我也不用亲自——

say:18:1222707013:1.text: It moved! We've got a bite!

choice:3:0:1.text: Want me to help you fish?
choice:3:0:1.male: Want me to help you fish?
choice:3:0:1.female: Want me to help you fish?
